hints.content:
The number lines show that the ratio of $\maroonD{\text{games}}$ to $\blueE{\text{percentage}}$ is $\maroonD{250}:\blueE{100\%}$.

We are looking for ratios that are equivalent to $\maroonD{250}:\blueE{100\%}$.

$\maroonD{250}\div \maroonD{50}= \purpleE{5}$

So, we can find the percentage for $\maroonD{50}$ games by dividing both parts of the ratio by $\purpleE{5}$.

[[☃ image 1]]

So $\blueE{20\%}$ of $250$ is $\maroonD{50}$.

options.alt: A double number line with 3 unequally spaced tick marks. The line labeled Games, reads from left to right: 0, 50, 250. The line labeled Percentage, reads from left to right: 0 percent, 20 percent, 100 percent. An arrow from the pair 250 to 100 percent to the pair 50 to 20 percent is labeled divided by 5.

hints.content:
$\maroonD{150}\div\maroonD{50}=\purpleE{3}$

Now we can find the percentage for $\maroonD{150}$ games by multiplying both parts of the new ratio by $\purpleE{3}$.

[[☃ image 1]]

So $\blueE{60\%}$ of $250$ is $\maroonD{150}$.

options.alt: A double number line with 4 unequally spaced tick marks. The line labeled Games, reads from left to right: 0, 50, 150, 250. The line labeled Percentage, reads from left to right: 0 percent, 20 percent, 60 percent, 100 percent. An arrow from the pair 50 to 20 percent to the pair 150 to 60 percent is labeled times 3.

hints.content:
###Completed table

Games | Percentage
:-:|:-:
$250$ | $100\%$ of $250$ games
$50$ | $20\%$ of $250$ games
$150$ | $60\%$ of $250$ games
